subject.title: fix(onboard): honor remote flags in interactive setup

question: Should OpenClaw accept the documented interactive-onboarding contract that explicit remote flags override stored values for that invocation and that an endpoint change clears inherited credentials unless a replacement token is given?
rationale: The patch is technically bounded and proven, but it defines compatibility-sensitive behavior for public setup flags and remote credentials; the protected maintainer label requires an owner decision before merge.

options.title: Accept the repair
options.body: Merge after refreshing against current main, retaining explicit flag precedence and credential isolation as documented.

options.title: Pause for a different contract
options.body: Keep the PR open only if maintainers want explicit URL changes to preserve a different stored-credential behavior and can specify that supported upgrade contract.

recommendation.title: Accept the repair
recommendation.body: Merge after refreshing against current main, retaining explicit flag precedence and credential isolation as documented.
